patterns.note: A full-screen overlay navigation is used, triggered by a hamburger icon, presenting menu items in a clean, high-contrast monospace style.
Exclusive use of a monospace font for all text elements, including headings, body, and navigation, creating a consistent, technical, and precise aesthetic.
A stark, high-contrast palette of black backgrounds and white text is dominant, with occasional deep blue or dark red accent sections providing visual breaks.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience facilitated by locomotive-scroll.
The initial hero image features a subtle parallax scroll effect, where the background image moves slower than the foreground text elements, adding depth.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-triggered animation library (like locomotive-scroll) to orchestrate section reveals, where content fades in and slides up from the bottom as it scrolls into view, creating a dynamic but controlled flow.
A full-screen overlay navigation is implemented, appearing from the right with a dark background and light monospace text, covering the main content when active.
High-contrast dark mode design with a consistent monospace typeface applied globally, ensuring a unified and precise visual tone across all content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Consistent monospace font used throughout; headings are uppercase and moderately larger than the small, uppercase body text, maintaining a precise, technical feel.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and a balanced density within sections.

standout: The exclusive and rigorous application of a monospace font for all text elements, from hero headings to body copy and navigation, combined with a high-contrast black and white palette, creates a uniquely precise, technical, and sophisticated aesthetic that feels distinct from typical modern marketing sites.
